offering_description.value: Herbalife sells meal replacements, dietary supplements, sports nutrition products and personal care products to consumers. It develops its own formulations, uses both company-operated plants and contract manufacturers, and sells primarily through independent distributors.

primary_products.value: Meal-replacement shakes and protein foods; vitamin, herbal and digestive supplements; sports nutrition products; teas and energy drinks; skin and body care products

customer_segment.value: B2C: Consumers seeking weight management, daily nutrition, sports performance or personal care products; B2B: Independent distributors who buy products for resale

end_markets.value: Weight management; dietary supplements and wellness; sports nutrition; functional beverages; personal care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Nutrition and personal care products purchased by independent distributors and preferred customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes nutrition ingredients into finished products sold through independent distributors; brand owner: Develops formulations and sells products made by contract manufacturers through its distributor network

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific, including China and India

specialization.value: related lines: Weight management, daily nutrition, sports nutrition, functional beverages and personal care sold through a shared distributor network

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent direct-selling distributors, including operators of nutrition clubs; online: Company and distributor storefronts for customer orders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA food and supplement manufacturing and labeling rules, plus FTC oversight of marketing claims and direct-selling practices

notes: The current commercial scope of Herbalife’s personalized nutrition tools is uncertain.
